title: Secrets request
description: The body of the signed POST to the configuration's secrets.url that fetches the values of a run configuration's credentials: when the run starts, and again for the entries whose values expire (run-configuration.schema.json, credentials). It is signed under the access key as every POST to the server is: the request string's last line is this body. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object. At most 32 KiB.

version.description: The document format. A server refuses another version, 400 invalid_request.

run_id.description: The run's id, as its registration or its run key contains it: a canonical lower-case UUID.

run_configuration.description: The digest of the run configuration whose credentials the request is for: sha256= and the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the document's bytes, as its X-Qory-Run-Configuration header contained it.

credentials.description: The names of the entries of that run configuration's credentials whose values the server seals, in the document's order, each once: every entry when the run starts, and at a renewal the entries that are due, with entries due within 30 seconds of each other in one request.

timestamp.description: The sender's clock, in decimal seconds since the Unix epoch. The server accepts it within 300 seconds of the server's clock, else 401. It is a JSON integer below 2^53, with no sign, fraction or exponent; the server checks the form when it decodes.
